_comment: Elections the close-races tracker follows on its own (docs/elections/ga-close-races.md, "Unattended operation"). Per entry: the election date and kind; the SOS id if known (null: found in the SOS election list by date and kind); watchStartUtc, when the watch workflow and watchdog start it; stopAfter, the last day either keeps it running (past state certification). cities: elections a city runs itself, outside the SOS feed, read from its own results page (scripts/lib/city-results.mjs). Each city contest lists its candidates as the city qualified them.
